blockers.issue: Authentication-Results aggregated over all headers with trusted authserv-id: attacker can inject own header; Gmail uses header.i not header.d; naive ';' split allows comment injection.
blockers.fix: Trust ONLY the topmost Authentication-Results (get_all()[0]) whose authserv-id equals configured id; RFC 8601 tokenizer stripping comments/quoted strings; dkim domain from header.i or header.d; strict alignment of dkim domain and smtp.mailfrom domain with From domain; require dmarc=pass header.from==From domain; exactly one From header + one address (getaddresses strict), reject non-ASCII. Tests: injected trusted-id header below the real one, comment-injection fixture, real Gmail header with header.i.

blockers.issue: extract.extract_from_text counts every \d+ as an amount, so typed 'pay 123' yields amount 123.00; with a payee in quoted text and no other amount it would pay R123.
blockers.fix: Strip the matched trigger span from typed_text before candidate extraction. Test: 'pay 123' + payee, no amount -> must NOT produce 123.00.

blockers.issue: Typed-vs-forwarded split relies on marker heuristics; unrecognised forward/quote markers (Afrikaans/Dutch Outlook, mobile, inline forward, HTML blockquote only) leave third-party text in typed_text so a third party's 'pay 123' triggers.
blockers.fix: Fail closed: if ANY forward/reply indicator (Fwd/FW/Re prefixes in several locales, message/rfc822 part, In-Reply-To/References, HTML blockquote/gmail_quote/divRplyFwdMsg/moz-forward) and no confident split, typed_text=''. Prefer HTML structure; never search the subject for the trigger. Tests: unknown-locale forward, no-marker forward, HTML-only Gmail forward each with third-party 'pay 123' -> ignored.

blockers.issue: instruction_id derived from extracted fields (message_id, amount, payee, currency): same message processed twice with different extraction yields a second id and a second payment; empty Message-ID collides.
blockers.fix: instruction_id = sha256(normalised Message-ID | outer From) ONLY; reject missing Message-ID; keep a processed-message record for EVERY outcome (incl. ignored/parked); create() returning created=False never executes and never notifies again.

blockers.issue: Registered immediate path has no message-age check: unread backlog at first deployment, re-marked-unread mail, or reprocessing after retention cleanup pays an old instruction (F16 unmet).
blockers.fix: Add PAYMENTS_MAX_MESSAGE_AGE_HOURS (fail-closed default, e.g. 24) measured from Gmail topmost Received header or IMAP INTERNALDATE, never the Date header; older -> expire+notify, never pay; retention_days >> this window. Tests for both.

blockers.issue: 0013 status CHECK has no pre-claim state for registered instructions, no crash-recovery rule, no expiry for awaiting_confirmation, undefined 'parked'; migration lands in it2 before S11 is designed; later fix needs 0014.
blockers.fix: Write the full state/transition table BEFORE S9: add 'accepted' (registered pre-claim); after crash execute an accepted row only if fresh else expire; awaiting_confirmation gets expiry; define parked terminal vs re-checkable. Freeze the CHECK list from that table.

blockers.issue: S1 _cycle_kwargs calls settings.notify_recipients() and S11 reads settings.payments_mode; existing CLI tests stub Settings.load with classes lacking both -> AttributeError rc=2, breaking existing tests that may not be edited.
blockers.fix: Read new settings via getattr with safe defaults (pattern at cli.py:300): notify recipients default empty, payments_mode default 'legacy'. Add a test with a minimal stub settings object.

blockers.issue: Single Gmail account: our own notifications arrive From an allowlisted DKIM/SPF-passing address; a template/quote/subject containing 'pay'+3 digits or a confirm keyword makes the bot trigger/confirm itself.
blockers.fix: Every outgoing mail: Auto-Submitted: auto-generated + X-Invespend-Notification + recognisable Message-ID; ignore inbound mail carrying them (fails closed). Test: parse_trigger and command parser return none on every rendered template.

blockers.issue: Consolidated approval email carries several [INV-ref] tags; find_ref returns the first so approving item 2 is checked against item 1; lookup placed after source last-3 resolution so reply without last-3 is parked source_unresolved.
blockers.fix: Resolve the pending record from the token's nonce (stored on the record) or require exactly one ref; do the lookup BEFORE step 1 using the record's stored source. Two-item test.

tightenings.fix: allow_redirects=False on write path; map 3xx and undecodable 200 bodies to unknown/needs_review; legacy catches per message.
claim_for_execution: INSERT day row ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING then SELECT FOR UPDATE; POST outside any DB transaction; only flip submitting->needs_review when updated_at older than a threshold.

Refuse to run unless IMAP_MAILBOX is a dedicated label/mailbox (IMAP fetch marks mail read); gate workflow on repo variable PAYMENTS_CYCLE_ENABLED (default off); payment secrets in a GitHub Environment restricted to main; workflow test asserts INVESTEC_PAYMENTS_ENABLED is not true.
Check store reachable BEFORE fetching mail; after fetch any failure sends owner a generic 'cycle failed' notice; document init-db must run before v2 is enabled.
Add currency to ImageFields; non-ZAR symbol = conflict; reconciled currency must be ZAR or park.
Store keyed HMAC of extracted account number; awaiting->held only on exact name AND (HMAC match when a number was extracted); registered path with number mismatch parks+notifies.
beneficiary_fingerprint uses HMAC with env secret; build from raw list (from_api drops accountNumber).
Ambiguous registered match (>1 same name) -> park+notify; only 'no match' goes to new_payee.
PAY_TRIGGER_RE: [ \t\u00a0]? not \s?; [0-9] or re.ASCII; right boundary (?![0-9A-Za-z.,]); add 'pay123abc','pay 123,000','pay\n123' to grammar table.
Command (cancel/confirm) only from typed text first non-empty line; both keywords -> no-op; confirm must be authenticated and within awaiting_confirmation expiry.
Same source+payee+amount within N days -> park 'possible_duplicate' and notify.

HUMAN DECISION: route registered beneficiaries whose first_seen_at is later than now-hold to the held path (with first-deploy bootstrap: beneficiaries present when v2 is enabled count as established), or document accepted Investec-rejection risk. Planner: offer both; default = hold-if-recent.
Help byte-compare: set COLUMNS via monkeypatch inside test; fixtures tied to Python 3.12.
Document legacy exit 2 when recipients set but signing secret missing; guard approval email (skip+audit when secret invalid); avoid resending every cycle.
v2 error envelope prints exception class + scrubbed message.
Test: no image-extractor call for unauthenticated or untriggered message.
